The `getGlobalProperty` call sites in the REST module are in `openmrs-module-webservices.rest`, not `openmrs-core`. Callers that reach the core service directly are the ones a behaviour change would hit. I checked the bodies of the first five files; the one-line entries (RestUtil 226, 614, 846 and SwaggerSpecificationCreator 174) are cited from search results only.

**Production code that calls `getGlobalProperty` (best first):**

1. **`RestUtil.getGlobalProperty` (line 71-79)** is the wrapper all the limit and config lookups go through. The `/ws/rest/v1` pagination and error handling depend on it.
2. **`RestUtil.getDefaultLimit` (line 87-101)** reads the default page size. A changed return value changes how many results every resource returns.
3. **`RestUtil.getAbsoluteLimit` (line 109-123)** reads the absolute result cap.
4. **`RestUtil` line 226** reads the allowed-IPs property, which is used for access control.
5. **`RestUtil` line 614** sets `RestConstants.URI_PREFIX` from a global property, which changes the REST URL prefix.
6. **`RestUtil` line 846** reads the stack-trace-details flag, which controls what error responses expose.
7. **`VisitConfigurationController2_0.getCurrentConfiguration` (line 55-69)** reads the assignment handler and the enable-visits flag.
8. **`VisitConfigurationController2_0.getEnableVisitsValue` (line 102-106)** reads the enable-visits flag with a default of `"true"`.
9. **`VisitConfigurationController2_0.getVisitTypesToAutoCloseValue` (line 140-160)** parses the auto-close visit types list.
10. **`LocaleAndThemeConfigurationController2_0.getCurrentConfiguration` (line 35-45)** reads the default theme and locale.
11. **`LayoutTemplateProvider.getPopulatedTemplateDefaults` (line 82-87)** reads the layout defaults property, which feeds the name and address templates.
12. **`SwaggerSpecificationCreator` (line 174)** reads the quiet-docs flag.

**Indirect or weaker paths:**

13. **`ImplementationIdController2_0.getCurrentConfiguration` (line 37-42)** calls `administrationService.getImplementationId()`. In core, `AdministrationServiceImpl` appears to implement that by reading `GLOBAL_PROPERTY_IMPLEMENTATION_ID` through `getGlobalProperty` (core `api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/AdministrationServiceImpl.java:476`). I did not open that method, so treat this as likely rather than confirmed.
14. **`SystemSettingResource1_9.doSearch` (line 236-241)** uses `getGlobalPropertiesByPrefix`, not `getGlobalProperty`. It is listed because it depends on the same GP store.

**Tests that would break if the behaviour changed:**

15. **`ObsResource1_9Test` (line 64-67)** reads two global properties with `getGlobalProperty`.
16. **`NameTemplateController2_0Test` (line 63)** reads the name format property.

Falkon's search limit was reached before I could finish a full list of callers. I did not check the remaining references in `SettingsFormController`, `SystemInformationResource1_8` or the other `openmrs2_0` controllers for indirect calls.
